rows.summary: http-cache-semantics max-stale handling can disclose cross-user cached responses

exposure.boundary: Astro remote image build cache; static Pages has no shared Node cache
exposure.condition: Shared per-user cached response plus attacker max-stale request. Astro observed code constructs its own image Request and uses storable/timeToLive, not client max-stale reuse; exploit path not demonstrated.
exposure.gate: No verified published fixed candidate. Upstream patch/parent fix or separately approved expiring exception required; retain high-severity block.
